faq.question: Apakah perlu mengunduh atau membuat akun?
faq.answer: Tidak. Permainan berjalan di browser tanpa akun. JavaScript dan browser yang mendukung WebGL diperlukan untuk bermain.

faq.question: Apakah semua habitat langsung terbuka?
faq.answer: Perjalanan dimulai di Macaw Aviary. Perluasan Elephant Grove, Lion Savanna dan Giraffe Plains mengikuti progres serta misi zoo.

faq.question: Apakah isi ulang langsung memenuhi kebutuhan satwa?
faq.answer: Tidak. Isi ulang menyiapkan stok pakan, air atau pengayaan. Satwa perlu mencapai fasilitas dan memakainya sampai selesai agar mendapat manfaat.

faq.question: Apakah Zebra Grasslands sudah bisa dimainkan?
faq.answer: Belum di versi publik. Gambar Zebra Grasslands di halaman ini adalah pratinjau build V5. Saat ini kamu bisa memainkan empat habitat melalui progres zoo.

faq.question: Di mana progres disimpan?
faq.answer: Progres disimpan lokal di profil browser ini saat penyimpanan tersedia. Tidak ada sinkronisasi antarperangkat. Menghapus data situs akan menghapus progres lokal.

h1: Build your 3D zoo. Care for every resident.

faq.question: Do I need a download or an account?
faq.answer: No. Play in your browser without an account. JavaScript and a WebGL-capable browser are required to play.

faq.question: Are all habitats open from the start?
faq.answer: Your journey starts at Macaw Aviary. Elephant Grove, Lion Savanna and Giraffe Plains unlock through zoo progress and missions.

faq.question: Do refills immediately satisfy animal needs?
faq.answer: No. Refills prepare food, water or enrichment supplies. Animals need to reach a facility and finish using it to benefit.

faq.question: Can I play Zebra Grasslands now?
faq.answer: Not in the public version. The Zebra Grasslands images on this page are previews of the V5 build. You can currently play four habitats through zoo progress.

faq.question: Where is my progress saved?
faq.answer: Progress stays locally in this browser profile when storage is available. There is no cross-device sync. Clearing site data removes local progress.
